instruction: Show me the steps to make the opening paragraph of my document display in red text.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the font color of the first paragraph to red (RGB: 255, 0, 0). The evaluator checks if all text in the first non-empty paragraph has red color applied (with 10-unit tolerance per RGB channel to account for palette variations). Custom getter extracts font color from the first paragraph, and custom metric compares against expected red color with tolerance.
metadata.verification: Verified by reading the original document structure - it has 5 paragraphs with the first paragraph containing course aims. The evaluator checks if the font color is set to red in the first paragraph after the user applies the change. Tolerance is included to account for different red shades in LibreOffice color palettes.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the single requirement: first paragraph font color is red (RGB: 255, 0, 0)
Getter logic correctly extracts font color from the first non-empty paragraph by reading all runs and returning the color (or most common color if mixed)
Metric logic correctly compares result vs expected color with tolerance (10 units per RGB channel) to handle LibreOffice color palette variations
Postconfig appropriately saves the document (Ctrl+S) to persist changes before verification
Expected value is semantically correct: has_color=true and color=[255, 0, 0] matches the instruction requirement for red text
Data flow is correct: getter extracts color -> metric compares with tolerance -> returns 1.0 for match or 0.0 for mismatch
The getter handles edge cases: checks for non-empty paragraphs, validates runs exist, returns None/False for missing data
